== Documentation ==
The <code>DefaultAliasDisableHavokOnLoad.psc</code> source file documentation comments for this script.

<source>
Disable havok on a ref OnLoad(), then optionally enable havok OnHit(), OnActivate(), or OnGrab()
</source>
